templates.name: Minimal Static App
templates.description: A smallest useful MoonCraft app shape: MoonBit renders one static HTML page and a native async/http backend serves it directly. Use this when an agent needs a minimal web preview without browser-side MoonBit bundles.

templates.name: Todo Isomorphic App
templates.description: A full-stack MoonBit web app using the frontend/shared/backend layout from MoonBit's multiple-target architecture. The Rabbita JavaScript frontend and Mocket native backend share typed DTOs, JSON derivations, and validation from the shared package.

templates.name: Interactive Presentation
templates.description: A full-stack MoonBit presentation app for code-powered decks, live metrics, speaker notes, timers, layout presets, a lightweight 3D MoonBit word viewer, and interactive slide components. The Rabbita JavaScript frontend and Mocket native backend share deck DTOs, JSON derivations, validation, and navigation rules through the shared package.

templates.name: Wasm Mandelbrot App
templates.description: A MoonCraft web app focused on browser WebAssembly compute. The frontend package exports MoonBit functions as a Wasm module, a small native async/http backend serves the browser shell and Wasm artifact, and there is no shared package because the backend does not consume domain types.

templates.name: Selene Minesweeper Game
templates.description: A browser game template using Selene with the selene_webgpu backend. The JavaScript frontend owns the game loop and rendering, while the native async/http backend stays minimal and only serves the generated game asset and browser shell.

templates.name: Selene 3D Tank Game
templates.description: A browser 3D game template using Selene with the selene_webgpu backend. The JavaScript frontend owns a 1920x1080 tank arena with camera, lighting, keyboard movement, mouse-driven tank view and turret turning, click-to-fire projectile gameplay, moving enemy tanks, enemy turret tracking and firing, obstacle collision, tank collision, projectile hit rules, and parent-child tank render rigs with detailed primitive parts, while the native async/http backend only serves the generated game bundle and browser shell.
